recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; revisit only if a future Patient search-parameter change reintroduces a provider/organization ambiguity.
issue_request: FHIR-3485 was a Published/Persuasive Patient change request saying the Patient "provider" search parameter pointed at Patient.managingOrganization even though the intended care-provider path was Patient.careProvider; PA accepted separate organization = Patient.managingOrganization and careprovider = Patient.careProvider search parameters.
initial_application: Git commit 5415ea6b96 explicitly applied Task #3485 by renaming the old provider search row to organization on Patient.managingOrganization and adding a separate careprovider row on Patient.careProvider.
additional_context: FHIR-7963 later renamed Patient.careProvider to Patient.generalPractitioner, and git commit fb14d2fad1 applied that rename to the Patient element and search parameter. Patient is active in source/fhir.ini, and current Patient search-parameter source has Patient-general-practitioner on Patient.generalPractitioner and Patient-organization on Patient.managingOrganization.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current source correction is needed.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Patient.careProvider to Patient.generalPractitioner, explaining the current search parameter name and expression.
